inspectorDialog.title: Inspector in which city?
inspectorDialog.description: {{name}} will see the agenda and the inspections assigned in this city.

removeDialog.title: Remove the inspector role?
removeDialog.description: {{name}} can no longer receive inspections. Their future assigned inspections go back to the queue.

blockDialog.title: Block {{name}}'s account?
blockDialog.description: The account stays in the database and you can unblock it at any time.

consequences.signIn: They can no longer sign in, and open sessions are ended.
consequences.listings: Their published listings leave the site until they are unblocked.
consequences.bookings: Their future inspection bookings are cancelled.
consequences.visits: If they are an inspector, their future visits go back to “Unassigned”.

unblockDialog.title: Unblock {{name}}'s account?
unblockDialog.description: They can sign in again and their suspended listings return to the site. Cancelled inspections are not restored.

adminDialog.title: Make {{name}} an admin?
adminDialog.description: They will have full access to the admin panel: listings, appointments and users, and will no longer use the user panel. The role reaches their account within an hour or at their next sign-in.

weekly.title: Weekly schedule
weekly.selfDescription: The hours when you can take new bookings, every week.
weekly.adminDescription: The hours when the inspector can take new bookings.

dialog.title: {{day}} schedule
dialog.description: Up to 4 ranges a day. With no range, the day stays off.

empty.title: No exceptions scheduled
empty.text: The weekly schedule applies without breaks. Add an exception for leave, days off or blocked hours.

dialog.title: Add an exception
dialog.description: No new bookings reach you during this time.
